Save-the-Dates vs. Invitations: When to Send Each

Not sure when to send save-the-dates, or if you even need them? Send save-the-dates 6–8 months before the wedding, or up to a year ahead for a destination wedding. Invitations go out about 8 weeks before (12 for a destination). Here's what goes on each, who gets which, and when you can skip save-the-dates altogether.

Read the full guide: https://bridalteam.com/guides/save-the-dates-vs-invitations?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-13-noon-save-the-dates-vs-invitations
